matches.scene: pond + red barn + aspen reflection
matches.title: Golden Sanctuary
matches.why: Sheet names a serene pond + rustic barn + golden aspens + mountains; W20 is the only plate with pond AND barn.

matches.scene: river bend, red rock cliff wall
matches.title: Autumn's Crimson Passage
matches.why: Sheet: stream alongside crimson rock walls + golden aspens. W15's red cliff is unique on the site.

matches.scene: lake with a lone small boat, aspen slopes
matches.title: Crystal Reflections of Gold
matches.why: Sheet: a lone canoe on a calm mountain lake among golden aspens. W17 is the only plate with a boat.

matches.scene: split-rail fence winding through golden field, Sopris at sunset
matches.status: STRONG — CONTESTED by Twilight Over the Golden Glade
matches.title: Path to the Summit
matches.why: Sheet: wooden fence winding through a golden field, snow-capped mountain, warm sunset light — four exact elements. Twilight's sheet also claims fences at sunset but centers an aspen grove, which W30 is not.

matches.scene: rustic fence + shed in glowing aspens
matches.title: Hidden Glow in the Forest
matches.why: Sheet names a rustic fence in a forest lit by golden leaves; W18 is the only fence-in-grove plate.

matches.scene: lake edge, aspen hillside, snowy ridge beyond
matches.title: Autumn Symphony at the Lake
matches.why: Sheet: mountain lake + golden aspens + snow-capped peaks in the distance. W17 is taken by the canoe sheet; W19 fits the rest.

matches.scene: aspen grove interior, sunburst through canopy
matches.title: Light's Golden Embrace
matches.why: Sheet: aspen grove glowing, sunlight streaming through. W9 is the site's grove-sunburst hero.

matches.scene: gravel track through cathedral aspen grove
matches.title: Golden Pathway Through Aspen Grove
matches.why: Sheet: sunlit pathway through a grove of golden aspens. W29 is the grove track; W23 is a mixed-forest trail.

matches.scene: dirt road toward massive snow-capped peak
matches.title: Path to Alpine Splendor
matches.why: Sheet: dirt path framed by aspens + evergreens toward snow-dusted peaks under blue sky. W24 matches element for element.

matches.scene: Sopris over meadow, storm skies, red shrubs (variant pair)
matches.title: Autumn's Radiance
matches.why: Sheet: golden aspens + vibrant red oaks foreground, snow-capped mountains under DRAMATIC skies. The storm light is the discriminator vs W21's clear day.

matches.scene: Sopris over sage meadow, clear blue sky
matches.title: Golden Pastures Beneath the Peaks
matches.why: Sheet: golden meadows + fiery red oaks leading to snow-capped peaks under a vibrant BLUE sky.

matches.scene: one glowing golden tree in dark brush, gray snowy range
matches.title: Golden Light Beneath the Peaks
matches.why: Sheet: a single golden-lit tree standing out against rugged wilderness + snow-dusted peaks. W22 is built on exactly that.

matches.scene: ranch valley wide — pasture, animals, barn, aspen hillsides
matches.title: Valley of Gold
matches.why: Sheet: valley of golden aspens + peaks + 'the harmony between nature and rural life.' W16 is the only working-ranch valley.

matches.scene: sparkling straight river reach, blue sky
matches.title: Radiance Along the Stream
matches.why: Sheet: a SPARKLING mountain stream under a clear blue sky. W14's riffles sparkle; other creek plates are shaded or calm.

matches.scene: rapids running toward viewer through cottonwoods
matches.title: Whispers of Autumn's Light
matches.why: Sheet: a river with CASCADING waters. W31 is the only rapids plate.

matches.scene: cabin nestled in aspen grove (variant pair)
matches.status: SCENE MATCHED — VARIANT SPLIT IS RON'S
matches.title: Aspen Refuge AND Sanctuary of the Whispering Woods
matches.why: Both sheets describe a cabin in a golden aspen grove; the site holds two variant frames of one cabin scene. Likely one title per variant — Ron assigns which.

matches.scene: creek with vivid red banks
matches.title: Autumn's Whispering Creek
matches.why: Sheet stresses fiery red foliage at a creek; W7's red banks dominate. Creek set is family-resemblance — Ron confirms.

matches.scene: calm creek bend, reflective water (variant pair)
matches.title: Autumn's Tranquil Flow
matches.why: Sheet: peaceful creek, golden + red foliage, soft light. Calmest of the creek scenes.

matches.scene: creek through dense luminous forest (variant pair)
matches.title: A Song of the Autumn Forest
matches.why: Sheet: winding creek through a luminous forest, sunlight through the canopy.

matches.scene: creek meandering past a foreground boulder (variant pair)
matches.title: Golden Symphony Along the Stream
matches.why: Sheet: a tranquil stream meandering through golden foliage in soft sunlight.

matches.scene: broad river, cottonwoods, pine mountain
matches.title: Rivers of Gold
matches.why: Sheet: a vibrant river through golden forest with rocky banks — the biggest water of the creek/river set.

matches.scene: leaf-covered forest trail, mixed aspen + pine
matches.title: The Golden Way
matches.why: Sheet: dirt trail through golden aspens AND evergreen pines toward peaks. W23 matches trail + mixed forest; peaks not visible in frame.

matches.scene: forest road / rocky path toward snowy peak
matches.title: Pathway to the Peaks
matches.why: Sheet: dirt road in a mountain valley toward snow-capped peaks. Both W25 (spruce road) and W26 (rocky path, peak-dominant) fit; the other stays unmatched for now.

matches.scene: valley vista — winding creek, ski-slope mountain
matches.title: Autumn's Requiem in the Highlands
matches.why: Sheet: a river winding through a valley of golden aspens with distant peaks. W8 is the only elevated valley-vista plate.

matches.scene: aspen wall + ranch corral
matches.title: Mountain Refuge in Gold
matches.why: Sheet is generic ('mountain retreat among golden aspens'). W11 is the only unmatched aspen-ranch scene; Ron confirms or rejects.

matches.scene: sunset Sopris
matches.title: Golden Glow Beneath the Alpine Shadows
matches.why: Sheet has no description, alt says only 'golden glow at sunset, Mount Sopris' (and wrongly 'in Aspen' — ARTEMIS flag). No discriminating element; Ron assigns.

matches.scene: fence + sunset
matches.title: Twilight Over the Golden Glade
matches.why: See Path to the Summit entry. If Ron gives W30 to Twilight, Summit needs a new home.

meta.by: LUNA (visual pass over all 31 thumbs; scene notes in plate-scene-notes.md)
meta.rules: CONFIRMED/STRONG = unique-element visual matches LUNA verified by eye. PROVISIONAL = family resemblance only — ships nowhere until Ron confirms. CONTESTED = two sheets claim one scene (or one sheet, two scenes) — Ron resolves. Panorama sheets are separate composite works and never bind to the 3:2 site plates.
